cues: One drawing tip that saves marks.
A secondary wavelet is a tiny spherical wave, not a ray.
Draw arcs of radius v t from points on the old wavefront, and then their common tangent.
Students who draw straight arrows instead lose the whole proof.
text: One drawing tip that saves marks. A secondary wavelet is a tiny spherical wave, not a ray. Draw arcs of radius v t from points on the old wavefront, and then their common tangent. Students who draw straight arrows instead lose the whole proof.
